theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Utilities (+2.90%) and Real Estate (+0.98%) led the market today, while Health Care (-0.04%) and Financials (+0.07%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.50%, defensives +1.25%, and value/cyclicals +0.55% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.58%, Dow +0.49%, Nasdaq +0.45% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.59%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 3.29% to 15.01, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.90% to $4,191.80, crude oil was little changed at $90.07, and bitcoin slipped 0.09% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
